title: The Last Sigil Revisited
author: Y. M. Zhou
blurb: Silas Dravenmoor, an exiled storm-caller, has spent fifteen years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
